standard-dialogue-if-the-player-is-a-hou.player: [House owner] killed an abyssal demon! Cool!

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-is-a-hou.speaker: Abyssal demon
standard-dialogue-if-the-player-is-a-hou.text: Cool for [him/her/them] maybe. How would you like to be stuck on a wall?

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-is-the-h.speaker: Abyssal demon
standard-dialogue-if-the-player-is-the-h.text: Have you considered visiting THE ABYSS?

options.text: I visit the abyss all the time

steps.player: I visit the abyss all the time!

steps.speaker: Abyssal demon
steps.text: I bet you just rush through it though. Everyone there is in such a rush. No one stops to appreciate the beauty of THE ABYSS.

options.text: I have to run through quickly or I'll die

steps.player: I have to run through it quickly or I'll die!

steps.speaker: Abyssal demon
steps.text: Death is a small thing compared to the beauty of THE ABYSS.

options.text: The abyss looks pretty ugly to me

steps.player: The abyss looks pretty ugly to me.

steps.speaker: Abyssal demon
steps.text: Poor deluded fool. There is no hope for you at all.

steps.speaker: Abyssal demon
steps.text: But does not the fear contribute to your appreciation of THE ABYSS?

steps.speaker: Abyssal demon
steps.text: Poor human. You must not judge THE ABYSS by the standards of this world. You must learn to embrace your fear as part of the experience of THE ABYSS.

options.text: I suppose fear does heighten the senses

steps.player: I suppose fear does heighten the senses.

steps.speaker: Abyssal demon
steps.text: Then you should enhance them further by raising the stakes. Next time you go to THE ABYSS you should take all your most valuable items with you.

options.text: Could I get an abyssal whip?

steps.player: Could I get an abyssal whip?

steps.speaker: Abyssal demon
steps.text: You must take all your gold and all your most valued items, and take them into THE ABYSS without weapons or armour.

steps.player: And then will I get an abyssal whip?
